parts:
There was a New York Times article about expressing uncertainty of vaccine results.  See below.  Relates to a new paper we have on preprint and a related one coming out in Journal of Clinical Epidemiology.

If you’re interested, check it out, and retweet anna’s tweet!

 

 

From The New York Times:

What Do Vaccine Efficacy Numbers Actually Mean?

All of the F.D.A.-approved vaccines offer strong protection against Covid-19, and assessing their efficacy isn’t as simple as a head-to-head comparison.
